headline: Every Hungarian with a Loan Could Get Burned: Planned Overhaul May Bring Shocking Price Increases
summary: Speakers at a Budapest debt collection conference warned that a slower payment order procedure and harder claim enforcement could push up loan rates. About 400,000 to 500,000 such procedures are started in Hungary each year.
why: Changes to debt enforcement affect lenders' credit risk and borrowing costs, which feed into bank earnings and the broader credit market.
